sources.locator: FAQ: Is preventive maintenance the same as repair? Can one Asset have several tasks?
sources.observed: In ERPNext, no: Maintenance is planned work. Asset Repair records failure, downtime, repair cost, possible capitalization. One Asset can have several tasks (rows).

sources.locator: Asset Repair docs + v15.117.0/v16.28.0 release notes (PR 57110/57077); Downtime Entry minutes vs Analysis hours
sources.observed: Repair records failure + financial/operational recovery; consumed parts included, inventory reduced. v15.117.0/v16.28.0 allow Repair for fully depreciated assets, Capitalize Repair Cost locked, no value/life add. Downtime Entry in minutes, Analysis in hours.

sources.locator: Self-host guide (full IdP, 2025.10 no Redis); Snipe-IT LDAP setup; proxy outpost X-Authentik-* headers; SAML field map
sources.observed: Full IdP OIDC+SAML+LDAP+user mgmt+social; since 2025.10 no Redis, only Postgres, 4->3 containers. LDAP: Integration+Password Sync checked, AD unchecked, ldap://host, TLS/cert flags. Proxy outpost forwards X-Authentik-*; SAML expects mail/givenname/sn etc.

sources.observed: Service+SDKs; backends Postgres/Mongo stable, MySQL/SQLServer beta, others alpha/experimental; SDKs JS/RN/Flutter/Kotlin/Swift stable, others beta/alpha. uploadData() only while sync stream connected, queue buffers offline.
